description: CONTROL group experience: weight-tuning lessons (manual RL). Every insight is a weight_delta; no structural feature was added. Policy-Ablation control, NOT the HL main line.

lessons.source: railgun uses: humans fire 1-3 per game
lessons.evidence: Ranked humans use railgun to clear blocking walls and reopen expansion lanes. v6 never fired one.
lessons.insight: Hold the railgun for when a wall blocks expansion; don't ignore it.

lessons.evidence: my=20 hu=146 rounds=125 my_splits=2 opp_splits=2 deaths=1 opp_big_gains=0

archived.evidence: ranked humans split at round 10-22 when snake length 9-16; they reach 4 snakes; I (v6) capped at 3 and lost the tempo race.
archived.insight: Split aggressively once length>=9 and there is room; cap should be 4 snakes, not 3, to match human action economy.

archived.evidence: Humans perform burst seals from round ~25 onward, gaining +6 to +20 walls per seal. v6 almost never sealed big.
archived.insight: Sealing is the primary territory mechanism, not slow crawling. Weight seal_area higher and lower the seal threshold in mid-game.

archived.evidence: my=24 hu=84 rounds=120 my_splits=2 opp_splits=4 deaths=0 opp_big_gains=0
archived.insight: opp split 4x vs my 2x -> split more; territory deficit (24 vs 84) -> seal more

archived.evidence: Against rank15 my snakes get boxed in and die mid-game; single-step flood-fill keep-alive undercounts future traps.
archived.insight: Survival is the ceiling. Add a trap_penalty and pocket-avoidance term; consider 2-step lookahead for the survival gate.
